 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. This hybrid role combines enterprise AI architecture, Supply Chain taxonomies and knowledge graph, product thinking, and client advisory to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into scalable AI solution architectures.
* Design and architect enterprise\-grade AI applications leveraging LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Multimodal AI patterns.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures, including model selection, data retrieval strategy, orchestration frameworks, deployment models, and integration patterns.
* Design and implement advanced prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and memory management strategies.
* Architect hybrid retrieval solutions using vector search, semantic search, GraphRAG, SQL\-based retrieval, and vectorless approaches.
* Design and implement MCP\-based integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and business systems.
* Establish AI platform standards covering observability, evaluation frameworks, LLMOps, monitoring, governance, performance optimization, and cost management.
* Define AI security architectures addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, jailbreak attempts, and AI\-specific threats.
* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI principles, privacy regulations, governance requirements, and security standards.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof\-of\-concepts, and production\-readiness evaluations.
* Drive AI adoption across business and technology teams through workshops, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor AI engineers, architects, and developers while defining best practices, reusable frameworks, and reference architectures.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to drive continuous innovation.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related technology domains.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, embeddings, reranking, and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of AI agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, memory strategies, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Proficiency in Python, API development, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI services.
* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Practical experience with MCP, REST APIs, JSON\-RPC, OAuth, and secure integration frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.
* Understanding of model fine\-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, model routing, quantization, and inference optimization techniques.
* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and presenting architecture roadmaps, AI strategies, and business cases.

 The PKI and Encryption Specialist is responsible for the design, implementation, and daily management of the organization’s Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and cryptographic systems. You will ensure secure communications and data integrity by managing the full lifecycle of encryption keys and digital certificates.

* Infrastructure Management: Maintain and support enterprise\-level PKI solutions (e.g., Microsoft ADCS, PrimeKey EJBCA, or Entrust).

* Automation: Implement automated certificate enrollment and renewal processes using protocols like SCEP, EST, or REST APIs to prevent service outages caused by expired certificates.
* Policy \& Compliance: Develop and enforce Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statements (CPS) to ensure alignment with industry standards like NIST or FIPS.
* Crypto\-Agility: Lead efforts to transition from legacy algorithms (e.g., SHA\-1\) to modern standards and prepare for post\-quantum cryptography.


**Technical Skills Required**
* Cryptographic Protocols: Deep understanding of TLS/SSL, SSH, PGP, and IPsec.
* Identity Management: Experience with Active Directory (AD), LDAP, and their integration with PKI for auto\-enrollment.
* Encryption Platforms: Hands\-on experience with tools like Gemalto KeySecure, Thales CipherTrust, or HashiCorp Vault.
* Cloud Security: Familiarity with cloud\-based PKI services (e.g., AWS Certificate Manager, Azure Key Vault) and "PKI as a Service" (PKIaaS) models.

Work alongside your global SRE team, executing on projects in your product\-area specific reliability roadmap, to optimize operations, increase efficiency in our use of cloud resources and our developer’s time, harden security posture, and increase feature velocity of our developers Work closely with multiple teams to optimize the operations of their microservices \- and improve the lives of the engineers within your product area engineering team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support the engineering teams within your product area by maintaining and executing a reliability roadmap of opportunities for improvement for reliability, maintainability, security, efficiency, and velocity \- and help for realizing those opportunities.

* Participate in defining, evolving, and managing SLOs for several teams within your product area.
* Participate in on\-call rotations within your product area to understand operations workload so you can continually work to improve the on\-call experience and reduce operational workload for running microservices and related components.
* Complete projects to optimize and tune on\-call experience for your engineering teams.
* Continually improve the lifecycle of microservices and architectural components from inception and design, through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Write code and automation to reduce operational workload, increase efficiency, improve security posture, eliminate toil, and enable Sumo’s developers to deliver features more rapidly.
* Work closely with the developer infrastructure teams to expedite development infrastructure adoption of tools to advance your reliability roadmap by identifying needs for your supported engineering teams, and contributing back features and bug fixes when needed.
* Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
* Facilitate blame\-free root cause analysis meetings for incidents to learn and drive improvement
* Participate in and continually improve our global IRC (incident response coordination) for all products.
* Drive root cause identification and issue resolution with the teams.
* Work inside of a fast\-paced iterative environment.
* Hire \& Mentor new team members.


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* Cloud native application development experience leveraging best practices and design patterns
* Strong debugging and trouble\-shooting skills across the entire technology stack
* Deep understanding of AWS Networking, Compute, Storage, and managed services.
* Competency with modern CI/CD tooling like Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible \& Jenkins
* Experience with full life cycle support of services, from creation to production support
* Versed in Infrastructure as Code practices using technologies like Terraform or Cloud Formation
* Ability to author production ready code in at least one the following: Java, Scala or Go.
* Experience with Linux systems and at home on the command line
* Understand and apply modern approaches to cloud\-native software security
* Experienced with agile frameworks, such as Scrum and Kanban, and how to operate within these frameworks to continually deliver value.
* Flexible and willing to step into new roles and responsibilities
* Willingness to learn and use Sumo Logic products for solving reliability and security issues
* Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or another scientific or technical discipline
* 8\+ years of professional experience in applied software security role


**Desirable Skills**
* Experience using Sumo Logic products or other observability products for reliability and security
* Experienced with planet scale product development
* Running and operating SaaS products on AWS Cloud with expert level proficiency
* Experience with streaming technologies like Kafka, Kafka Streams, or KSQL
* Expert level experience in one or more of: Java, Go, Scala, or Python
* Expert level experience in one or more of: Terraform, Jenkins, Kubernetes
* Extensive experience running and tuning JVM workloads at scale


**About Us**
 Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI\-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. * At least 9 years of professional experience in private cloud technologies, particularly OpenStack and Linux administration.

* Strong Linux administration expertise, including operating system optimisation, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build strong customer engagement.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities.

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 8\+ years of experience
   

  

**Job Description**
 The File \& Object Storage Engineering team delivers scalable, secure, and automated file and object storage platforms supporting enterprise application onboarding, data center builds, and rapid data growth across lines of business.
   

  

 The File and Object senior infrastructure engineer is tasked with the design, configuration, and ongoing engineering of the organization’s file storage platforms. This role requires the engineer to collaborate with application teams, assisting them in onboarding their applications to utilize file and object storage solutions. Additionally, the engineer provides support with data migrations and engages closely with vendors to facilitate enhancements and resolve technical issues.
   

  

 One of the key responsibilities of the engineer is to identify and implement automation opportunities that streamline daily activities. This includes provisioning, data migrations, and addressing security remediation asks. The engineer also serves as an escalation point for the operations team, providing expertise and guidance for complex issues.
   

  

 Key scope includes:
   

  

* Deliver end‑to‑end provisioning (file shares and object buckets) aligned to SLA targets and enterprise demand
* Support large‑scale onboarding, data migrations, and capacity expansion for new data centers and platforms
* Drive adoption of automation (API) to reduce manual workflows and improve TAT
* Enable standardized, policy‑driven provisioning and improve accuracy, governance, and reporting
* Support platform stability by resolving complex issues and acting as escalation point for provisioning and platform incidents
* Partner with architecture, security, and platform teams to support enhancements, certification, and long‑term platform evolution
* Contribute to improving customer experience by enabling self‑service, reducing rework, and simplifying workflows


 This role is critical to sustaining provisioning throughput, enabling data center expansion, and accelerating the shift toward automation‑first, API‑driven storage delivery.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 
+ 4–6 years of infrastructure or storage engineering experience
+ Experience supporting enterprise file and/or object storage platforms
+ Strong troubleshooting and operational support skills
+ Experience working in SLA‑driven environments


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 
+ Hands‑on experience with file and object storage provisioning and support
+ Experience managing provisioning requests, onboarding, and data migrations
+ Understanding of storage lifecycle (capacity, performance, lifecycle mgmt.)
+ Experience with scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Ansible)
+ Knowledge of OS (Linux/Windows) and networking fundamentals
+ Ability to handle L2/L3 escalation and drive issue resolution
+ Experience working with cross‑functional teams (app, infra, vendors)
+ Focus on improving TAT, reducing manual effort, and standardizing workflows


**Desired Qualifications**

+ Experience with NetApp ONTAP and enterprise object storage platforms
+ Exposure to self‑service provisioning (IDP), APIs, and automation at scale
+ Familiarity with cloud storage platforms and container environments
+ Understanding of security, compliance, and governance in storage
+ Ability to contribute to automation improvements and operational initiatives
